“Reality is consistent because someone keeps the minutes.”

Noise: +3

You are licensed to administer continuity of meaning: what counts as having happened, how strongly the past pulls on the present, and which version of events becomes official.

Esoteric Bias: Divination (Chokhmah) and Illusion (Hod). When casting manifestations from these schools, misalignment penalties are suppressed; aligned casting generates +1 Surge.

Always Prepared Manifestations: Long Ledger, Penalty Clause, Clause Lantern, Standing Oath, Cite Precedent.

Unique Contract: Binding Precedent (see Pactkeeper features).

🧭 PACTKEEPER FEATURE: Jurisdiction

Type: Permanent class feature (Level 1)
Purpose: Defines what you are authorized to administer

A Jurisdiction does not grant power directly.
It grants permission.

What Jurisdiction Does

Your Jurisdiction determines:

  • Which situations generate Surge more easily

  • Which effects you may enforce without Noise

  • Which Contracts you can issue by default

  • Which manifestations are considered “in mandate”

Example:

  • A Steward acting on community Loyalty = in mandate

  • A Steward issuing divine sanctions = out of mandate (Pressure risk)

Jurisdiction Is NOT:

  • A resource pool

  • A bonus to rolls

  • A manifestation list restriction

It is a scope limiter and Pressure filter.
